blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Made with 100% Real Cheese From Master Cheese Makers
paragraphs: We Start with Premium Cheese then we Bake it to Crunch

As Cheese Whisperers™, we bring artisanal cheese into snacking. Made with Aged Asiago and Pepper Jack cheeses selected by Master Cheesemakers, we grate and then bake into crunchy satisfying crisps. Real Cheese. Real Snacks.

†Milk is obtained from cows that are not treated with rBST. No signigicant difference has been shown between milk derived from cows treated with synthetic bovine somatotropin and milk derived from untreated cows.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Perfect for snacking straight out of the bag or adding to soups, salads or an appetizer plate.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Asiago cheese (pasteurized part-skimmed cow's milk, salt, cheese cultures, enzymes), pepper jack cheese (cultured pasteurized cow's milk, jalapeños, habaneros, salt, dried chipotle chiles, enzymes, annatto [color]).
Packaged in a facility that also packages tree nuts.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Product sold by weight, not volume. Contents tend to settle after packaging. Some breakage may occur.
